name: HighLevel (GoHighLevel)
description: HighLevel (commonly called GoHighLevel or GHL) is an all-in-one business platform that combines a CRM, funnel and website builder, email/SMS marketing, booking calendars, and workflow automation into a single subscription, aimed at replacing several separate tools with one system that agencies can white-label and resell to their own clients.
best_for: Marketing agencies and SaaS-minded solo operators who want to run and resell client CRM, funnels, and automation from one white-labelable platform instead of stitching together separate tools.
features: Unified conversations inbox (calls, SMS, email, social DMs)
Agency "SaaS mode" for white-labeling and reselling to clients

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: 3 sub-accounts, unlimited contacts and users, core CRM/marketing features, 24/7 support.

tiers.name: Unlimited
tiers.notes: Unlimited sub-accounts, ability to rebill phone/email usage to clients, basic API access.

tiers.name: Agency Pro (SaaS Mode)
tiers.notes: SaaS mode for automated sub-account creation and reselling with markup, advanced API access.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Custom pricing via sales; dedicated support, custom development, white-label mobile app, HIPAA-compliant option.

pros: Genuinely consolidates CRM, funnels, email/SMS, and scheduling into one subscription
Agency-focused white-label/reselling ("SaaS mode") is a real differentiator most CRM competitors don't offer
Large, very active user community across Facebook and elsewhere for support and templates
cons: Steeper learning curve than a single-purpose CRM given how many tools it replaces
Community discussion shows a meaningful freelancer/agency self-promotion layer around the ecosystem, which can make impartial troubleshooting harder to find
Add-on usage (phone minutes, SMS, email sends) is billed separately from the subscription and can be confusing to estimate upfront

faq.question: Is GoHighLevel the same as HighLevel?
faq.answer: Yes — "HighLevel" is the company's current brand name; "GoHighLevel" (and "GHL") are the names most commonly used by its user community and in search, both referring to the same product.

faq.question: Does GoHighLevel replace a CRM like HubSpot or Pipedrive?
faq.answer: It can — GoHighLevel includes CRM pipelines alongside funnel building, email/SMS, and scheduling. Buyers choosing between GoHighLevel and a standalone CRM are usually trading a single-purpose, easier-to-learn tool for a wider all-in-one platform with a bigger learning curve.

alternatives.name: HubSpot
alternatives.description: A CRM platform that centralizes contact, deal, and marketing data, with a genuinely usable free tier.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses that want a single-purpose CRM with strong free-tier onboarding rather than an all-in-one agency platform

alternatives.name: Zoho CRM
alternatives.description: A configurable CRM that is part of Zoho's wider suite of connected business apps.
alternatives.best_for: Budget-conscious teams who want CRM plus optional access to Zoho's broader app suite

alternatives.name: Pipedrive
alternatives.description: A sales-focused CRM built around a visual deal pipeline.
alternatives.best_for: Sales teams who want a simple, pipeline-first CRM without funnel-builder or SaaS-reselling features
